title: 第4章 天才与废物

content_zh:
昆仑历时代的网络已经全面进入了公历时代小说中那种虚拟的网络，在网上，甚至能够和在现实里一模一样，没有什么区别的。
本来以人类的科技，是决然没有可能就这样进入到这种虚拟网络之中的，按照历史书上的记载，是人类在进军昆仑界的过程之中，得到了一件很厉害的宝物，名为虚境，现代所有的网络，都是以虚境为核心构建的，这才是虚拟网络能够成型的根本原因。
而现在人人习武，现实里比斗切磋容易受伤，但是网络上就不会了，所以在网上各种武斗的都很多，甚至都有直播，尤其是那些厉害的高手之间的比斗，那就更是场场爆满，许多人都会去看。
而武斗直播的大热，自然也催生出了许多的解说，许多厉害的解说，能够随时随地的报出这些高手用的什么招式，并且推断两人之间的胜负之类的。
而这些解说也往往很容易产生很多粉丝，厉害的解说，赚的也很多。
“哥，你这也太小看我了，我在网上解说武斗比赛的视频，那点击量都有好几百万了，所以才有直播网站愿意请我做现场解说呢！”楚晴萱掩饰不住的兴奋说道。
“那行，你就去做呗，没想到我妹妹还成了网络红人了，看来以后不能小看你了啊！”楚云凡摸了摸楚晴萱的小脑袋说道。
仔细想想他也就不奇怪了，要想做这种武斗比赛的解说，必须对各种武学，还有形势判断都非常厉害。
楚晴萱在这方面天赋极好，虽然不能修炼，但还是眼光比他可要强的多了，平时她没事在网上呆着也就只有不断的学习了，可惜也就不能够修炼，否则直接修炼到气海境，甚至更高都毫无问题。
“那是，你肯定不能小看我！”楚晴萱仰着小脑袋，一副常胜将军的骄傲小模样，看着甚是可爱。
蓦地，门又是自动模样的男子。
“爸！”
“爸，你回来啦！”
楚云轩兄妹两人连忙说道，这人正是楚家一家之主，楚文成。
楚文成只是这昆仑历时代一个很普通的上班族，每个月拿几千块钱的工资，也就够刚刚养家罢了。
楚文成有些许疲惫，但是当看到了两个子女的时候，脸上还是露出了几分笑容。
“都回来啦，正好，吃饭！”杨雅芸走了出来，将饭菜都一一端上了锅。
虽然都是家常菜，但是如果在公历时代，这一桌饭菜的价格低不了，各种人参，鹿茸，灵芝等等，现在这些曾经少见的补品都能够大规模养殖，而且快速催熟，人参起码都是百年以上的年份，因为技术成熟，所以与自然成型的都没有什么分别。
如果不是这样的饮食已经做到走入千家万户，也撑不起现在人人修炼的大修炼时代。
吃到一半，楚文成突然开口说道：“对了，有一件事情我差点都忘记说了，大哥今天给我发了请帖，让我们去参加一个月后云天的生日宴会，刚好也是庆祝云天考上武科班！”

“不去，去什么去，除了借机收份子钱之外，还不是为了嘚瑟显摆他儿子考上武科班呗！”杨雅芸饭碗一推，直接说道。
“大哥也不是那个意思！”楚文成看着生气的老婆，不由得连忙开口说道。
“什么不是那个意思，大哥大嫂什么人我不了解吗，不就是想显摆他儿子呗，这些年这都多少次了，我就想不明白了，楚文成，你也是爸的儿子吧，凭什么呀，大哥的儿子出生的时候，爸亲自回家族去求了一颗洗髓丹帮云天洗经伐髓，那我们云凡呢，就晚了几天，不是长房长孙又怎么了，这些年有什么好事什么时候轮的到我们的！”杨雅芸秀眉微蹙，直接说道，“我们萱萱自小身体不好，求爸借点钱看病都难，但是这些年爸妈花在云凡身上多少钱，偏心也不能这样啊！”
楚文成讪讪的一笑，说道：“你也知道，我们这一脉已经没落很久，难得出了个云凡这样有天分，爸妈也是指望他光宗耀祖！”
“什么有天分，要是没有爸给他求回来的洗髓丹，加上从小到大，几万几十万的买各种珍贵药材让他浸泡，他能有这样的修为？”杨雅芸不由得说道，“楚文成，我们家已经够困难的了，我们萱萱看病都没钱，爸妈还要你借钱给大哥家，这些年你陆陆续续借了三十几万出去，有见到回头钱吗？”

content_en:
The Internet in the Kunlun Calendar Era has fully entered the virtual network in the novels of the Gregorian Calendar Era. On the Internet, it can even be exactly the same as in reality, with no difference.
Originally, with human technology, it was absolutely impossible to enter this kind of virtual network. According to records in history books, during the process of entering the Kunlun Realm, humans obtained a very powerful treasure called the Virtual Realm. All modern networks are built with the Virtual Realm as the core. This is the fundamental reason why virtual networks can take shape.
Nowadays, everyone practices martial arts, and it is easy to get injured in real-life fights, but this is not the case on the Internet. Therefore, there are many kinds of martial arts fights online, and there are even live broadcasts. Especially the fights between powerful masters, the venues are full, and many people will watch them.
The popularity of martial arts live broadcasts has naturally spawned many commentators. Many powerful commentators can report the moves used by these masters anytime and anywhere, and deduce the outcome between two people.
And these commentators often easily generate many fans, and good commentators can make a lot of money.
"Brother, you are looking down on me too much. The videos of me commentating on martial arts competitions on the Internet have received millions of clicks. That's why a live broadcast website is willing to ask me to be a live commentator!" Chu Qingxuan said with excitement that she couldn't hide.
"Okay, just do it. I didn't expect that my sister has become an Internet celebrity. It seems that I can't underestimate you in the future!" Chu Yunfan touched Chu Qingxuan's little head and said.
It's not surprising if he thinks about it carefully. If you want to be a commentator for this kind of martial arts competition, you must be very good at various martial arts and situation judgment.
Chu Qingxuan is extremely talented in this area. Although she cannot practice, she still has a much better vision than him. She usually has nothing to do but stay online and study continuously. Unfortunately, she cannot practice. Otherwise, there will be no problem in directly cultivating to the Qi Sea realm or even higher.
"That's right, you definitely can't underestimate me!" Chu Qingxuan raised her little head, looking as proud as a victorious general, she looked very cute.
Suddenly, the door opened automatically again.
"Dad!"
"Dad, you're back!"
Chu Yunxuan brother and sister quickly said that this person was the head of the Chu family, Chu Wencheng.
Chu Wencheng was just an ordinary office worker in this Kunlun era. His monthly salary of several thousand yuan was just enough to support his family.
Chu Wencheng was a little tired, but when he saw his two children, he still had a smile on his face.
"We're all back, it's time to eat!" Yang Yayun walked out and put all the food on the pot one by one.
Although they are all home-cooked dishes, if in the Gregorian calendar era, the price of this meal would not be lower. Various ginseng, velvet antler, Ganoderma lucidum, etc. Nowadays, these once rare supplements can be cultivated on a large scale and ripened quickly. The ginseng is at least a hundred years old. Because of the mature technology, it is no different from the naturally formed ones.
If this kind of diet had not reached thousands of households, it would not be able to support the current era of great cultivation where everyone is practicing.
Halfway through the meal, Chu Wencheng suddenly said: "By the way, there is one thing I almost forgot to mention. My eldest brother sent me an invitation today and asked us to attend Yuntian's birthday party in a month's time. It happens to be a celebration of Yuntian's entrance into the martial arts class!"
"No, why are you going? In addition to taking the opportunity to collect money from members, it's not just to show off that his son has been admitted to the martial arts class!" Yang Yayun pushed her job away and said directly.
"Brother, that's not what you meant!" Chu Wencheng looked at his angry wife and couldn't help but said quickly.
"That's not what you mean. I don't know who the eldest brother and sister-in-law are. I just want to show off his son. I have done this so many times over the years that I just can't figure it out. Chu Wencheng, you are also my father's son."Well, why, when the eldest brother's son was born, my father personally went back to the family to ask for a marrow-cleansing pill to help Yuntian cleanse the menstrual marrow and cut the marrow. As for us Yunfan, we were just a few days late. So what if we weren't the eldest grandson? Whatever good things have happened in these years, when will it be our turn! Yang Yayun frowned slightly and said directly, "We Xuanxuan have been in poor health since we were young. It is difficult to ask our father to borrow some money for medical treatment. However, how much money our parents have spent on Yun Fan over the years, we cannot be biased like this!" "
Chu Wencheng smiled coquettishly and said: "As you know, our lineage has been in decline for a long time. It is rare to find someone as talented as Yunfan, and his parents also hope that he will honor his ancestors! "
"What kind of talent is there? If his father hadn't begged him for the Marrow Cleansing Pill, and he had spent tens of thousands and hundreds of thousands on various precious medicinal materials for him to soak since he was a child, how could he have achieved such a level of cultivation? Yang Yayun couldn't help but said, "Chu Wencheng, our family is already in dire straits. We, Xuanxuan, don't even have money for medical treatment. Your parents want you to lend money to your eldest brother's family. You have borrowed more than 300,000 yuan over the years. Have you ever seen the money back?" "
